result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by industrial land use with significant infrastructure gaps, including a lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. A major safety hazard is present where a large commercial vehicle completely obstructs the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white utility truck is parked directly across the sidewalk, completely blocking pedestrian passage.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, in front of the tan building.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, despite the presence of a traffic signal.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has vehicle traffic lights but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the right.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement stricter parking enforcement or install bollards to prevent vehicles from obstructing the sidewalk.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked continental crosswalk at a signalized intersection, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. The area is characterized by industrial land use with a stone wall on one side that may obstruct sightlines, and inconsistent sidewalk provision.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks pedestrian signal heads, leaving pedestrians without clear guidance on when to cross.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A tall stone wall on the right side of the image creates a blind spot, potentially hiding pedestrians from approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Incomplete Sidewalk Network
hazards.description: There is no paved sidewalk visible on the right side of the street, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the stone wall

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide dedicated crossing phases and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the crosswalk to reduce crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk network to the right side of the street to provide a continuous, safe path for pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows an industrial intersection with a traffic signal but no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. The pavement is cracked and degraded, and there is a lack of clear separation between the roadway and pedestrian zones near the large brick building.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians unprotected.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and wear in the asphalt can create tripping hazards or cause vehicles to swerve.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated signals for pedestrians to know when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten crossing distances and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: This industrial street corner lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure despite being a signalized intersection. There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, and the sidewalk is obstructed by utility equipment and multiple wide commercial driveways.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks at a signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians unprotected and without a designated path.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility box and poles block the pedestrian clear path on the sidewalk, forcing users toward the road edge.

hazards.name: Frequent Driveway Conflicts
hazards.description: Multiple wide curb cuts for the auto body shop create numerous conflict points with vehicles entering and exiting.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers synchronized with the traffic light.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and proper slopes at the corner for accessibility.
